newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on borrowing interest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on borrowing interest.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates ended up on Tuesday on borrowing interest, but Wednesday's rates would depend on the result of a central bank open market operation, dealers said.
"Early in the morning, the overnight rates traded in the range of 10 to 13 percent. Later they shot upto 18 percent on borrowing interest," a dealer said.
Dealers said the rates on Wednesday would depend on the results of an open market operation set by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan on the same day. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
